text:
Blessed is the man who does not follow the Party's slogans

nor attend its rallies

nor sit at the table with the gangsters

nor with the Generals on the War Council

Blessed is the man who does not spy on his brother

nor denounce his schoolmate

Blessed is the man who does not read the commercial advertisements

nor listen to their radios

nor believe in their slogans.


He will be like a tree planted beside a spring.

translation.title: Blessed Is the Man Who Does Not Follow the Party's Slogans...
translation.editorial_note: This source repeats Psalm 1 under a title drawn from the first line; the translation keeps the same psalmic structure.
